_comment: ASVspoof 2019/2021 LA attack taxonomy. Transcribed from Table 1 and Section 3 of 'ASVspoof 2019: A Large-Scale Public Database of Synthesized, Converted and Replayed Speech' (Wang et al., 2020; arXiv:1911.01601). The ASVspoof 2021 LA eval set reuses the 2019 LA eval utterances (passed through codecs/transmission), so ONLY A07-A19 appear in the eval data; A01-A06 are train/dev (known) attacks. Category axis = conditioning mechanism (the basis of the text- vs speaker-conditioned degradation hypothesis). 'waveform_generator' is kept separate for a secondary vocoder-level cut.

neural_tts.expected_artifacts: prosody, spectral envelope, vocoder phase / high-frequency detail

concatenative_tts.expected_artifacts: segment/concatenation boundaries; preserves natural short-term acoustics

voice_conversion.expected_artifacts: F0 trajectory, spectral conversion, residual/filtering artifacts

A04.note: MaryTTS diphone unit-selection; preserves natural short-term acoustics. Same algorithm as A16.

A06.note: Transfer-function-based VC. Same algorithm as A19.

A07.note: NN TTS with GAN post-filter to mask vocoder artifacts.

A08.note: Like A01 but NSF waveform model (faster than WaveNet); one-hot speaker.

A10.note: End-to-end neural TTS with speaker-encoder (d-vector) transfer learning; high naturalness, overlaps bona fide in x-vector space.

A11.note: Same as A10 but Griffin-Lim waveform generation.

A12.note: Neural TTS on autoregressive WaveNet; F0+linguistic features as input.

A13.note: Unit-selection TTS (VoiceText) source + NN VC; direct waveform modification. Hard to detect.

A14.note: Commercial TTS source + VCC2018-style VC; STRAIGHT vocoder.

A15.note: Like A14 but speaker-dependent WaveNet vocoders.

A16.note: Same algorithm as A04, built on VCTK eval data. Known-reference system.

A17.note: Same VAE framework as A05 but direct waveform modification; highest spoofing capability reported in VCC.

A18.note: Non-parallel VC inspired by i-vector ASV framework.

A19.note: Same algorithm as A06, built on VCTK eval data. Known-reference system.
